phases.name: Walking skeleton (metadata, /wsfed, picker, wresult)
phases.description: Grow existing FederationMetadata and add /{tid}/wsfed so Priya completes SP-initiated sign-in: picker, registered wsfed-reply, SAML 2.0 wresult. Same cert. No second metadata URL or login UI.

steps.name: Complete clean WS-Fed walking skeleton
steps.description: In-process clean walking skeleton: metadata RoleDescriptor, /{tid}/wsfed challenge, existing picker, SAML 2.0 wresult to registered wsfed-reply.
steps.criteria: Existing FederationMetadata includes a WS-Fed RoleDescriptor with both STS endpoints at /{tid}/wsfed; Unauthenticated wa=wsignin1.0 challenge is login HTML, not 404 and not a wresult; Priya sees the same Pick an account chrome and the picker posts back to /{tid}/wsfed; Browser POSTs wa=wsignin1.0 and SAML 2.0 wresult to the registered wsfed-reply; Assertion Audience is api://tasks-api, Issuer equals entityID, wctx echoes, and NameID is persistent
steps.scenario_name: Priya completes Tasks API WS-Fed sign-in on a clean emulator
steps.implementation_notes: Grow existing FederationMetadata with a WS-Fed RoleDescriptor; both endpoints are /{tid}/wsfed; same signing cert as IDPSSODescriptor; metadata audit flow stays saml-metadata. New GET|POST /{tid}/wsfed; flow wsfed; ClientID is wtrealm; never persist wresult. Resolve wtrealm via GetAppByIDURI; accept wreply only as type wsfed-reply; do not use HasRedirectURI. Reuse picker via signed Kind wsfed; no second login UI. SAML 2.0 RSTR; Audience equals wtrealm; Issuer equals entityID. Analog saml.go, samlsso.go, samlrequest.go, Register, saml_*_test.go. Examples api://tasks-api and https://rp.example.test/signin-wsfed. Out of cut: SOAP, /common/wsfed, SAML 1.1, witnessed SLO, encryption.

steps.name: Finish FederationMetadata WS-Fed advertisement
steps.description: Remaining US-01 on the existing metadata URL: sign-out advertised, matching certs, IDPSSODescriptor, saml-metadata flow, no second URL.
steps.criteria: Sign-out URL is the same PassiveRequestorEndpoint as sign-in; This cut does not require a wsignout1.0 round-trip; WS-Fed signing certificate matches the SAML certificate; IDPSSODescriptor remains and metadata audit flow stays saml-metadata; Priya is not required to set MetadataAddress to a second URL
steps.scenario_name: Sign-out is advertised without a sign-out witness
steps.implementation_notes: Remaining US-01 on the existing FederationMetadata URL: sign-out advertised on the same PassiveRequestorEndpoint without a wsignout1.0 witness; certs match IDPSSODescriptor; IDPSSODescriptor remains; audit flow stays saml-metadata; no second metadata URL.

steps.name: Accept POST challenge and omitted wctx
steps.description: US-02: POST wa=wsignin1.0 starts the same challenge as GET. Omitted wctx is accepted and not invented later.
steps.criteria: POST to /{tid}/wsfed with wa=wsignin1.0 is not 404; Unauthenticated POST callers still see sign-in, not a wresult; Challenge without wctx still shows sign-in; Later token POST does not require a wctx the RP never sent
steps.scenario_name: POST as well as GET can start sign-in
steps.implementation_notes: GET already starts sign-in in 01-01. POST wa=wsignin1.0 must also reach the same challenge, not 404 and not a wresult. Omitted wctx is accepted. Later token POST must not invent a wctx the RP never sent.

steps.name: Reuse existing picker for WS-Fed
steps.description: US-03: same picker chrome as OIDC/SAML, password-required form, surviving challenge params, disabled users hidden.
steps.criteria: Password-required mode shows the same email and password form OIDC uses; Priya does not see a WS-Fed-specific login page; wtrealm, wreply, and wctx survive account choice; Disabled users are not listed as selectable accounts
steps.scenario_name: Password-required mode stays the existing form
steps.implementation_notes: Reuse existing picker chrome via signed Kind wsfed; POST action is /{tid}/wsfed; no second login UI. Password-required mode stays the existing email and password form. Challenge parameters survive account choice. Disabled users are not selectable.

steps.name: Complete remaining SAML 2.0 token fields
steps.description: US-04 remaining wresult fields: Issuer, Audience, SAML 2.0 version, wctx echo/omit, persistent NameID.
steps.criteria: Assertion Issuer equals FederationMetadata entityID; Token audience matches Application ID URI api://tasks-api; TokenType is SAML 2.0 and inner assertion Version is 2.0 not 1.1; wctx is echoed unchanged when sent and omitted when the RP never sent it; NameID format is persistent
steps.implementation_notes: Complete remaining wresult contract: Issuer equals metadata entityID, Audience equals wtrealm, SAML 2.0 TokenType and assertion Version 2.0 not SAML 1.1, wctx echo or omit, NameID format persistent. Same signing cert as FederationMetadata.

phases.name: Audit and existing-protocol guardrails
phases.description: WS-Fed challenge and success appear in existing Admin and Graph audit lists without token bodies. Growing metadata must not break existing SAML or OIDC sign-in.

steps.name: Record WS-Fed in Admin and Graph
steps.description: Admin and Graph lists show wsfed challenge, success with user, and refuse with Reason. URI ClientID maps to Tasks API. No wresult body.
steps.criteria: Admin records wsfed challenge without user and success with Alex Rivera, ClientID api://tasks-api; Neither admin event includes wresult or the assertion body; A refused challenge is recorded with flow wsfed and a concrete Reason; Graph identifies Tasks API from URI ClientID and appDisplayName is not blank; Graph marks the exchange interactive and omits wresult
steps.scenario_name: Challenge and successful sign-in are recorded without a token body
steps.implementation_notes: Audit wrap of /{tid}/wsfed is already in 01-01 (flow wsfed, ClientID is wtrealm, never log wresult). This step projects those events on Admin and Graph auditLogs/signIns. URI ClientID resolves to Tasks API appDisplayName. Flow wsfed is interactive. Refuse events carry a concrete Reason.

steps.name: Keep existing SAML and OIDC working
steps.description: Guardrail: e2e/saml and existing OIDC still complete after FederationMetadata grows a WS-Fed RoleDescriptor. IDPSSODescriptor remains.
steps.criteria: Existing SAML sign-in suite still completes after WS-Fed RoleDescriptor is present; IDPSSODescriptor remains on the same FederationMetadata URL; Existing OIDC sign-in still completes on the same emulator
steps.scenario_name: Existing SAML sign-in still completes after WS-Fed metadata growth
steps.implementation_notes: Growing FederationMetadata must not break existing SAML (IDPSSODescriptor remains, e2e/saml still completes) or existing OIDC on the same emulator. Same suites, not a new witness. Do not extend e2e/dotnet.

phases.name: Refuse unsafe realm, reply, unsolicited
phases.description: Unknown or empty wtrealm, unregistered or mistyped wreply, and unsolicited wresult are refused. Errors stay on the emulator. No token POST to an unowned URL.

steps.name: Refuse unknown and empty wtrealm
steps.description: US-06: unknown or empty wtrealm does not issue a token. No Location to an unowned URL. Error stays on the emulator.
steps.criteria: Unknown wtrealm does not POST wresult to the caller wreply; Empty realm is refused and no wresult is posted to wreply; Unknown realm never sends Location to an unowned URL; The error stays on the emulator
steps.scenario_name: Unknown application ID URI does not issue a token to the caller reply
steps.implementation_notes: Unknown or empty wtrealm does not issue a token to the caller reply. No Location to an unowned URL. Error stays on the emulator. Lookup is GetAppByIDURI; miss is refuse. Record failure with a concrete Reason.

steps.name: Filter wreply to registered wsfed-reply
steps.description: US-07: wreply must be an exact wsfed-reply for the wtrealm app. Refuse missing, unregistered, saml-acs-only, web-only, and cross-app URLs.
steps.criteria: Unregistered wreply does not receive a wresult; Missing wreply does not receive a token at a guessed URL; A reply registered only as saml-acs or web is refused; Another app's wsfed-reply is not accepted for this wtrealm
steps.scenario_name: Unregistered reply URL does not receive a token
steps.implementation_notes: Accept wreply only as an exact URI of type wsfed-reply for the app identified by wtrealm. Refuse missing, unregistered, saml-acs-only, web-only, and cross-app replies. Do not use HasRedirectURI. No wresult POST to those URLs.

steps.name: Refuse unsolicited wresult without challenge
steps.description: US-08: a wresult POST that did not start at this STS is refused. No allow-unsolicited flag in this cut.
steps.criteria: A wresult POST that did not start at this STS is not treated as successful sign-in; The Tasks API does not gain a session from that unsolicited token via this STS; Unsolicited login is not offered as a setting in this cut
steps.scenario_name: A token POST that did not start at this STS is refused
steps.implementation_notes: A token-shaped POST to /{tid}/wsfed that did not start with a challenge this STS issued is refused. No session via this STS. No v0.8.0 flag to allow unsolicited logins. Record failure with a concrete Reason.

phases.name: Environment matrix and stranger CI
phases.description: Sign-in still completes with existing OIDC/SAML config and after registering wsfed-reply on a stale directory. Unmodified WsFederation in e2e/wsfed is the KPI-1 witness.

steps.name: Prove pre-commit and stale-config sign-in
steps.description: WS-2 with-pre-commit alongside OIDC and SAML. WS-3 registers wsfed-reply on a stale SAML-only directory and never POSTs to a web-only redirect.
steps.criteria: Tasks API receives a SAML 2.0 wresult at its registered reply alongside OIDC and SAML; Existing OIDC and SAML sign-in still complete on the same emulator; After registering wsfed-reply on a stale SAML-only directory, sign-in completes; The emulator never POSTs wresult to a web-only redirect
steps.scenario_name: Priya completes Tasks API WS-Fed sign-in alongside existing OIDC and SAML
steps.implementation_notes: Unskip walking-skeleton environments with-pre-commit (WS-Fed alongside existing OIDC and SAML) and with-stale-config (register wsfed-reply on a directory whose metadata was SAML-only, never POST wresult to a web-only redirect).

steps.name: Witness unmodified WsFederation stranger sign-in
steps.description: KPI-1 / US-05: unmodified Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.WsFederation in e2e/wsfed completes metadata fetch plus sign-in. Sibling of e2e/saml, not e2e/dotnet.
steps.criteria: Priya pointed MetadataAddress and Wtrealm at the emulator without modifying the library; She changed only host and TLS knobs versus Entra; Unmodified middleware accepts the token and Priya has an authenticated session; The v0.8.0 witness is that library completing metadata fetch plus sign-in
steps.scenario_name: Priya's unmodified WsFederation middleware completes sign-in
steps.implementation_notes: KPI-1: unmodified Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.WsFederation completes metadata fetch plus sign-in. New e2e/wsfed sibling of e2e/saml. Register in e2e/run.py. Do not extend e2e/dotnet. Host and TLS knobs only. Do not log wresult in CI artifacts. See e2e/wsfed/README.md.
